question_or_proposition: For the authorized discharge at Outfall 001, does the cover-page authorization language establish that applicable effluent limitations, monitoring requirements, and other compliance conditions must be drawn exclusively from the cover page and Parts I–IV as named in the clause, and does the cover page itself impose independently enforceable conditions (such as authorized outfall scope, discharge location, or permit term) that bound which Part I–IV limits and monitoring requirements apply?
required_context: cover page authorization terms including Outfall 001 designation and permit effective period
notes: The nominated clause conjunctively conditions authorization on the cover page and on effluent limitations, monitoring requirements, and other conditions set forth in Parts I–IV. Resolving whether the cover page is an independent source of binding conditions versus an incorporation pointer, and whether all governing obligations are confined to those named parts, could change which limits are enforceable (A), which monitoring requirements are applicable (B), and how missing or conditional monitoring is classified when obligations depend on permit conditions located in those parts (C).
